questions.q: The minimum number of satellites for a position solution:
questions.explain: Four unknowns: x, y, z and the clock error.

options: An error multiplier from the geometry
questions.explain: All satellites on one side of the sky means a large DOP.

questions.q: Which is more accurate from a GPS receiver?
questions.explain: Doppler velocity: 0.05–0.2 m/s against 1.5–3 m for position.

questions.q: Which u-blox dynamic model suits a drone?
questions.explain: The pedestrian and automotive models smooth and lag.
It needs a carrier-phase receiver (in practice dual-frequency), a base and an RTCM stream.

questions.q: The main remedy for multipath from the frame:
options: A higher antenna, a ground plane
Disable GLONASS and keep only GPS
questions.explain: Reflections from the frame and the ground are the main source of jumps.

questions.q: What GPS rate is reasonable for a copter in ArduPilot?
options: 1 Hz: saves traffic and loads the UART less
50 Hz: the more often the better
The rate does not matter to the EKF
questions.explain: 5–10 Hz is enough; above that the EKF gains nothing, while the UART and the receiver get loaded.

questions.q: Why is UBX better than NMEA for an autopilot?
options: Every ground station and radio understands it without setup
It is binary, more compact and carries quality status
questions.explain: UBX is more compact and carries accuracy and status fields that NMEA lacks or carries only partly.

questions.q: ArduCopter 4.7.2, a GPS with a 3D fix sees 5 satellites. How does the autopilot respond to an attempt to arm in Loiter?
options: It arms: 5 satellites are enough for a 3D fix
"PreArm: AHRS: waiting for home": EKF3 did not take GPS (it needs 6), so there is no home
"GPS 1: Bad fix": it needs fix 4 or higher
questions.explain: EKF3 requires ≥ 6 satellites (`EK3_GPS_CHECK` bit 0); without GPS in the EKF home is not set, and the arming message names the consequence. In SITL: 5 satellites, refused; 6, armed.

questions.q: A u-blox MAX-M10S with the default constellation set (GPS + Galileo + BeiDou B1I) in normal mode outputs a navigation solution at up to:
questions.explain: Per datasheet UBX-20035208: 3 Hz for GPS + GAL + BDS B1I, 10 Hz for GPS + GAL; 25 Hz on four constellations is the NEO-M9N.
